headline: AEI: Romania's resource productivity has remained the same as 20 years ago, while in the EU it has grown by 50% - ProTV News
summary: An AEI analysis finds Romania's resource productivity has stayed at the same level as 20 years ago. Over the same period, resource productivity in the EU grew by 50%.
why: Resource productivity measures economic output per unit of material used, a gauge of efficiency and competitiveness. Weak gains can signal structural lag relative to European peers.
